bullets: In pursuance of your application followed by your interview, we are pleased to offer you the position of HR Coordinator, Ops with our client GIA India Laboratory Pvt Ltd at Mumbai on the mutually agreed terms and conditions. You are requested to join the services of GIA India Laboratory Pvt Ltd at the following address: GIA India Laboratory Pvt Ltd, Mumbai. The annual CTC shall be 3,23,076.00/-. The Salary structure is attached herewith as Annexure A. Please bring the following documents on the day of joining:
Salary slips of last three months, if applicable
Resignation acceptance letter from previous employer, if applicable
Cancelled cheque of savings bank account (in case employee wants to retain the existing A/c)
Copy of PAN Card & Aadhar Card and original for verification
Proof of Address (Voter ID, Passport, Aadhar Card, Driving License etc.)
Proof of Nationality (Voter ID card, Passport)
Pan-Aadhaar Linkage: Mandatory (Please share the receipt/screen shot of linkage)
* (Incase Pan and Aadhaar is not linked then please be apprised there would be 20% tax implications).
If you are an experienced professional, you can submit any one of the following for UAN: Previous employer payslip showing UAN, UAN passbook copy or UMANG App screenshot

If you are a fresher, you are required to create your UAN via the UMANG app. This letter of offer is issued to you on the presumption that the particulars furnished by you in your application are correct. With the receipt of the offer letter and sharing of your personal information, you hereby provide consent to PERSOL India Private Limited for the collection, use and disclosure of personal data by the employer and its affiliates, in accordance with the Company Policy. Please note that in case of any discrepancy in background verification, PERSOL and Client has rights to terminate the contract with immediate basis. Please reply with your acceptance of the offer within 48 hours of the receipt of offer. In case you fail to reply, this offer shall stand withdrawn after 48 hours. In case of any queries, feel free to contact the undersigned. Registered Office: Sriram Samanthu Chambers, #3287, 12th Main, HAL 2nd Stage, Indiranagar, Bengaluru - 560038 firozshaikh3759@gmail.com
